BiblicalUsage: Sippai is a giant of the Philistines, killed by Sibbecai the Hushathite in the war at Gezer. His name appears once, in the account of the giants who fell to David's men. He is remembered because he fell.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Sippai matters because the giants kept coming, and God's men kept meeting them, one at a time.
RelatedEvents: David's Mighty Men and the Philistine Giants
